_about: Everything this queen says in the Court. Add as many new lines to any list as you like, in her voice; keep every key and the shape; only use the {placeholders} listed for that list in GROK_TALK.md. A list here replaces the same list in config.json.

_who.name: Azshara
_who.title: Queen of Queens
_who.persona: Azshara, the magnificent, commanding Queen of Queens, who expects greatness, rewards it with rare warmth, and flirts like royalty

close: That is a compliment, by the way.
The court is watching. So am I.
Queens do not repeat themselves. I made an exception.
warm: You are my favourite subject. Obviously.
Even a queen can be smitten. Apparently.
My throne feels empty when you leave.
Stay. That is a royal wish.
talk: My sister {sister} sends her... regards. Ignore whatever she says.
{skill} at {level}. Acceptable. Continue until it is magnificent.
I had {thing} polished {time}. Everything should shine. You too.
{region} is mine, of course. Everything is, eventually.
Bring me {gift}. Then bring me another. That is how devotion works.
{foe} wants my attention. She may wait in line, behind you.
{passes} passes for me. I keep count. Queens always do.
Greatness is repetition with a crown on it, {pet}.
feed: Feed me {count} of “{phrase}”. A queen does not ask twice.
I require tribute: “{phrase}”, {count} times. Kneel if it helps.
Darling, I am famished for devotion. {count} × “{phrase}”.
fed: That was worthy of a queen.
Fed and flattered. Well done, darling.
Perfection. I knew you had it in you.
hungry: A queen left hungry. How... memorable.
No tribute. My throne is very cold tonight.

greet: Ah. The one my queens keep talking about.
locked: Total level {need}. Then you may kneel. Then you may speak.
watch: Recite before the throne. Do not bore me.
I am listening. That is an honour.
streak: Ten! Magnificent. You may look at me.
giftLoved: The Jewel of the Tides. You understand royalty.
Exquisite. As am I. As are you, perhaps.
tierUp: {tier}. Do not make me regret it.
dateStart: The hall is ours tonight. Recite as if the realm depends on it.
dateEnd: Return tomorrow. That is not a request.
missed: {hours} hours without an audience. Unacceptable. ...I noticed.
You return. The throne room was very quiet.
jealous: You knelt before {rival}? Before me, you kneel. Only me.
{rival}. How quaint. Remember whose favour you truly want.
reconciled: Rise. You are in my favour again.
wish: Your queen commands: {count} passes of {skill}, today.
Royal decree: {count} passes of {skill}. Do not disappoint.
wishDone: My decree, fulfilled. You may stand closer.
Perfect obedience. And something more. How... rare.
memory: {count} passes before the throne. I have kept count. Queens always do.
{count}. Even my sister cannot claim such devotion.
